name: Chillarón de Cuenca (Spain)
description: White field with a blue wavy bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, a blue disc in the lower hoist and a green tree in the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Chillarón de Cuenca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
